category phrases: `imports_file_not_found` none (the header is its predicate) | `several indexed files matched` | `several indexed .java files end with the specifier's path (or a prefix of it)` | `wildcard import` | `{verbatim} (no phrase for this category in this build)`, each followed by the reason clause, then the candidate clause; reason clause (from the metadata `basis`, on ANY category — the TS workspace ambiguity row keeps its own category, resolver.rs:690-704): `ambiguous_basename` → ` (same file name in {m} places)`, `ambiguous_suffix` → ` (same path suffix in {m} places)` with `{m}` the number of recorded candidate paths, ` (same file name in several places)` / ` (same path suffix in several places)` when the carrier holds no paths, `ambiguous_workspace_source_entry` → ` (several workspace source entries)`, any other string → ` ({verbatim} (no phrase for this reason in this build))`, absent → ` (reason not recorded)` after `several indexed files matched` and nothing on any other category; the candidate clause, prefixed ` — `, always follows the two ambiguity categories (`several indexed files matched`, `several indexed .java files end with the specifier's path (or a prefix of it)`) and follows any other category only for a Paths or unreadable carrier; candidate clause `{m} candidates: {p1}, {p2}, …` (every path, stored order) | `candidate paths not recorded with this import` (null) | `candidates unreadable ("{text}")`; classification phrases `external library?` | `this repository?` | `framework boundary?` | `unknown` | `{verbatim} (no phrase for this classification in this build)`; basis phrases `specifier matches a dependency declared in the manifest` | `specifier matches a tsconfig paths alias` | `specifier or its part before :: is on the runtime-module list of this build` | `recorded specifier starts with ., crate::, super:: or self::, or the specifier or target key contains :FILE` | `metadata carries a specifier and no rawPath, and the specifier's first segment before :: starts with a lowercase letter and holds only lowercase letters, digits or underscores` | `no classifier signal` | `{verbatim} (no phrase for this basis in this build)`;
